title: Hop limit not validated against MAX_HOP_LIMIT on parse
description: Lines 319-337, 383-401: MAX_HOP_LIMIT=15 defined but from_bytes accepts 0-255. Attacker can send messages with hop_limit=255. Fix: validate/clamp in from_bytes.
close_reason: Fixed: Clamp hop_limit to MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15) in Rreq::from_bytes to prevent flood amplification attacks. Added SECURITY comment and 3 tests.
